findings.description: The rewritten comment claims `state` "reaches the terminal only through equality against known literals," but `state` is printed raw (not equality-gated) at `src/cli/index.ts:1024` inside `sessionLine` (used by both `printDashboard` and `printFleet`), `src/cli/ui/sessions.component.tsx:60`, and `src/cli/ui/detail.component.tsx:24` — none of which are equality comparisons, and `sessions.state` has no SQL CHECK constraint (`src/core/db.client.ts:55`), so a foreign/fleet store (decision 60) can carry an arbitrary `state` value that reaches the terminal unsanitized.
findings.body:
This comment was rewritten by this commit to justify why `state` skips `sanitizeReason()` while `id` and `branch` don't, but the new justification doesn't match what the code does:

- `src/cli/index.ts:1024` (`sessionLine`, called from both `printDashboard` and `printFleet`): `` `${session.state.padEnd(16)} ${session.id.padEnd(28)} ${session.branch}${marker}` `` — raw interpolation, not an equality check. The fleet path is exactly the scenario this comment invokes (a store that "since the fleet view (decision 60), [is] not always the caller's own"), so this is reachable with a genuinely foreign `state` value.
- `src/cli/ui/sessions.component.tsx:60`: `{session.state.padEnd(STATE_COLUMN_CHARS)}` — raw JSX rendering.
- `src/cli/ui/detail.component.tsx:24`: `{row.session.state}` — raw JSX rendering.
- `src/core/db.client.ts:55`: `state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'queued'` has no `CHECK` constraint (contrast `ledger_entries.status`, which does), so nothing at the schema level restricts `state` to the known enum literals either.

The equality comparisons that do exist (`session.state === 'blocked'` at index.ts:1020, `STATE_COLOURS[session.state]` lookup) run *alongside* the raw print, not instead of it — a value that matches none of them still falls through to the raw `padEnd`/interpolation. The comment should state the actual justification (state is only ever set by the codebase's own writers to a known literal — if that's even true for a foreign store under decision 60) rather than a claim the code doesn't support.

<https://github.com/AlexisBalayre/pupitre/blob/245891d738cb8615cf38fb43b06c9c12feed27ba/src/core/dashboard.service.ts#L208-L210>
